description: React component for displaying and managing playlists in the music streaming platform frontend. Uses Redux for state management and React Router for navigation.

methods.name: Library()
methods.description: React functional component that lists playlists from Redux store, allows creation of demo playlist, and provides options to open or remove playlists.

methods.name: createDemo
methods.description: Creates a demo playlist with predefined tracks and dispatches an action to add it to the library.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Dispatches an action to remove a playlist by its ID.
